journey.name: delete newly saved contact
journey.description: Requires an authenticated disposable identity and a valid contact not already saved. The contact must have no active subscription. No payment is sent.

actions.action: Open Contacts and add the contact by its Pubky key
On the Contact Saved screen, tap Delete and confirm
Verify Contacts appears and the deleted contact is absent, with no empty contact screen
Navigate Back and verify the deleted contact screen is not restored
Add the same contact again and verify its saved details appear
